description: PPG Industries, Inc., incorporated in Pennsylvania in 1883, manufactures and distributes a broad range of paints, coatings and specialty products, with a vision to be the first-choice partner to meet its customers' evolving needs for innovative paints, coatings and surface solutions to protect and beautify the world, a proud heritage with a demonstrated commitment to innovation, sustainability, community engagement and development of leading-edge products, and it is a global leader that markets and sells in more than 50 countries. It supplies paints, coatings and specialty products to customers serving a wide array of end-uses, including industrial equipment and components, packaging material, aircraft and marine equipment, automotive original equipment, automotive refinish and aftermarket, pavement marking products, as well as coatings for other industrial and consumer products, and its Architectural Coatings segment, for example, primarily supplies a variety of decorative coatings, adhesives, sealants and finishes along with paint strippers, stains and related chemicals under brands including SIGMA, HISTOR, SEIGNEURIE, GUITTET, JOHNSTONES, LEYLAND, DEKORAL, GORI, BONDEX, DANKE! and TIKKURILA.
